verdict.rationale: The Data Protection practice page documents GDPR compliance work and explicitly includes regulator-facing work (CNIL sanctions proceedings), which touches the regulator-facing dimension of the story, but there is no explicit mention of security-incident or breach-response handling (e.g., breach notification, incident investigation, ransomware response) anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit breach/incident-response service description, breach notification workflow, evidence of handling live cyber incidents.
